cases.translation: I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
cases.explain: Ермо is the direct object of the transitive verb разобью (I will break), taking the accusative case, which for neuter nouns is identical to the nominative.

cases.sentence: Я надену на шею всех этих ___ ермо из железа.
cases.translation: I will put an iron yoke on the neck of all these peoples.
cases.explain: Народ is the direct object of надену (I will put), taking the accusative case, which for inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative.

cases.sentence: Тогда ___ Ханания снял ермо с шеи пророка Иеремии.
cases.translation: Then the prophet Hananiah took the yoke off the prophet Jeremiah's neck.
cases.explain: Пророк is the subject of the verb снял (took), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я верну сюда иудейского царя Ихонию и всех остальных ___ из Иудеи.
cases.translation: I will bring back here the Judean king Jeconiah and all the other captives from Judea.
cases.explain: After the word 'всех' (all), the genitive plural пленников is required to indicate the complete set of captives.

cases.sentence: Ты разбил деревянное ермо, но его сменит ермо из ___.
cases.translation: You have broken the wooden yoke, but a yoke of iron will take its place.
cases.explain: The phrase 'ермо из' (yoke of) uses the genitive case: из железа (made of iron).

cases.translation: I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
cases.explain: Ярмо as the direct object of разобью (will break) takes the accusative, which is the same as the nominative for neuter nouns.

cases.sentence: Не пройдет двух ___ как я верну сюда всю утварь дома Господня.
cases.translation: Within two years I will bring back all the vessels of the Lord's house here.
cases.explain: After numbers 2-4, the genitive case is used: двух лет (two years) — числа 2-4 + родительный.

cases.translation: The Lord will remove you from the surface of the earth.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) governs the genitive case: с лица земли (from the face of the earth).

reading.ru: Пророк Ханания, сын Азура из Гаваона, сказал мне в Доме Господнем, при священниках и при всем народе.
reading.question: Where did the prophet Hananiah deliver his prophecy?
options: In the Lord's house, in the presence of priests and all the people
reading.correct: In the Lord's house, in the presence of priests and all the people
reading.explain: The text states: сказал мне в Доме Господнем, при священниках и при всем народе — he spoke to me in the Lord's house, in the presence of priests and all the people.

reading.ru: Я разобью ермо царя Вавилонского. Не пройдет двух лет, как я верну сюда всю утварь дома Господня.
reading.question: What did Hananiah prophesy would happen to the king of Babylon's yoke and the Lord's vessels?
options: The yoke would be broken and the Lord's vessels returned within two years
The yoke would be strengthened for many years
The vessels would be melted down
The king would surrender to Judah
reading.correct: The yoke would be broken and the Lord's vessels returned within two years
reading.explain: Hananiah prophesied: Я разобью ермо ... Не пройдет двух лет, как я верну сюда всю утварь дома Господня — I will break the yoke, and within two years I will return all the Lord's house vessels here.

reading.ru: Пророки, что были до тебя и до меня, издревле пророчили многим странам и великим царствам войны, невзгоды и мор.
reading.question: What did the ancient prophets commonly prophesy to many nations and great kingdoms?
reading.explain: The text says: пророки ... издревле пророчили многим странам и великим царствам войны, невзгоды и мор — the prophets long ago prophesied to many nations wars, calamities, and pestilence.

reading.ru: Тогда пророк Ханания снял ермо с шеи пророка Иеремии и разбил его и сказал всему народу.
reading.question: What did Hananiah do to demonstrate his prophecy about breaking the yoke?
options: He took the yoke from Jeremiah's neck, broke it, and spoke to all the people
He wrote the prophecy on a scroll
He performed a ritual in the temple
He went to Babylon to confirm it
reading.correct: He took the yoke from Jeremiah's neck, broke it, and spoke to all the people
reading.explain: Hananiah пророк снял ермо с шеи пророка Иеремии, разбил его и сказал всему народу — took the yoke from Jeremiah's neck, broke it, and spoke to all the people.

reading.ru: Ты разбил деревянное ермо, но его сменит ермо железное, так говорит Господь сил, Бог Израиля.
reading.question: What does God tell Jeremiah to say to Hananiah about the yoke?
options: You broke a wooden yoke, but an iron yoke will replace it
You have proved the prophecy true
The Lord has sent you to save Israel
The wooden yoke was never real
reading.correct: You broke a wooden yoke, but an iron yoke will replace it
reading.explain: God tells Jeremiah: Ты разбил деревянное ермо, но его сменит ермо железное — You broke a wooden yoke, but an iron yoke will replace it.

reading.ru: Послушай, Ханания, Господь не посылал тебя, ты заставил этот народ поверить в лжи.
reading.question: What charge does Jeremiah make against Hananiah?
options: God did not send him, and he has caused the people to believe in lies
He has violated the temple laws
He has stolen from the treasury
reading.correct: God did not send him, and he has caused the people to believe in lies
reading.explain: Jeremiah says: Господь не посылал тебя, ты заставил этот народ поверить в лжи — The Lord did not send you, you have made this people trust in lies.
